about: InvestIQ carousel image bank: what each photo must show. Companies listed here get these hand-written shots first, then the build fills them to 10 from Commons (every other S&P 500 and well-known US-listed company is filled automatically: see universe). Topics and sectors have 10 shots each. A shot is a search string, or an object: q = Wikimedia Commons search, alt = fallback searches, scene = what the photo shows (also the AI prompt when Commons has nothing), person = a real person (never generated by AI), historic = an old photo is fine, orient = any (default), landscape or portrait, focus = [x, y] point the crop keeps (0-1), allow = words normally rejected in file names (logo, map, chart...). Sectors (GICS) fill companies that have fewer than 10 photos of their own.
style: Photorealistic editorial photograph, cinematic natural light, shallow depth of field, 35 mm lens, rich detail, vertical 4:5 composition with room for a headline. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
negative: text, letters, logos, watermark, signature, distorted faces, extra fingers, cartoon, illustration, low resolution
